mirror_base.description: Root directory where the mirror will be stored (must be an absolute path).

arches.description: List of CPU architectures to mirror.

items.description: A supported Debian architecture (e.g., amd64, i386, arm64).
A Debian distribution codename (e.g., stable, testing, bookworm, sid).

sections.description: List of component sections to include.

items.description: A section (component) in Debian repos (e.g., main, contrib, non-free).

method.description: Protocol to use for mirroring (http, https, ftp, or rsync).

remote_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the remote Debian mirror.

remote_dir.description: Remote directory path to mirror (relative to the remote host's root).

local_dir.description: Local absolute path to store the mirror (must exist and be writable).

arch_filter.description: Override architectures for generated .deb files. Leave empty to use 'arches'.

items.description: Architecture to include in local package index (e.g., amd64, i386).

exclude_sections.description: Sections to explicitly exclude from mirroring.

exclude_packages.description: Space-separated list of package names to exclude.

items.description: Package name to exclude (e.g., linux-image-*, firmware-linux).

include_packages.description: Space-separated list of packages to *only* include (if set, overrides excludes).

items.description: Package name or pattern to include (e.g., openssh-server).

compression.description: Compression format for .diff indices (gzip, bzip2, xz, or none).

udebs.description: Whether to mirror udeb packages (used by Debian installer).

debug.description: Whether to mirror debug symbol packages.

skip_nonfree.description: Skip non-free sections (set to true to exclude non-free).

skip_contrib.description: Skip contrib sections (set to true to exclude contrib).

skip_source.description: Skip source packages (set to true to exclude source archives).

skip_translations.description: Skip translation files (set to true to exclude po files).

rsync_options.description: Options passed to rsync command. Ignored if method is not rsync.

proxy_url.description: HTTP/FTP proxy URL (e.g., http://proxy.example.com:8080/). Empty to disable.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for network connections.

retries.description: Number of retry attempts for failed downloads.

logfile.description: Path to log file, or '-' to log to stdout.

md5sum_check.description: Verify MD5 checksums of downloaded files.

gpg_sign.description: Sign the Release file with GPG (enables offline integrity verification).

gpg_keyring.description: Path to GPG keyring (e.g., /etc/debmirror.gpg). Required if gpg_sign=true.

gpg_sign_key.description: GPG key ID or email address used for signing (e.g., A1B2C3D4, maint@example.com).
